Abstract Applet/Runnable with focus and window listeners; root of the Kickabout applet chain.
Result and memory int arrays refilled in 256-word batches, and contains the golden-ratio seed constant; same role as shared IsaacRandom.
RuntimeException wrapper retaining the original cause and appended client context string.
toString returns "LoggedGoal{..}" with scorer/ball positions, goal type (kick, cross, header) and match time.
Same shared role as GeoBlox IntrusiveNode: long key plus two node links; base of most Kickabout objects.
Per-participant flags printed by CommonGame.toString: offer_draw, resigned, departed, loaded_pitch, reward and megamode; decoded from the network buffer. Unrelated static helpers remain.
Power-of-two array of circular IntrusiveNode buckets keyed by long, implementing Iterable.
Same shared role as GeoBlox PacketBuffer: node subclass with byte payload, cursor and big-endian primitive/string/slice encodings.
toString returns "LoggedPlayer{..}" with home/away side, resign time, reward, membership, tackle, kick, cross, header and goal counters.
Power-of-two circular IntrusiveNode buckets keyed by long with insert, lookup and bucket-order traversal.
GameAppletShell subclass reading applet parameters (affid, gamecrc, gameport1/2, countrylist.ws) and owning shared account/connection client state; same role as Ace of Skies NetworkGameClient.
iw subclass owning the aq ISAAC generator for opcode encryption, matching the shared cipher buffer role.
Abstract synchronised match-state component with abstract copy-from and CipherPacketBuffer decode; every subclass toString is "Agent...".
MatchAgent whose toString prints "AgentFootballer[archetype]" with location, speed, action, direction, kick and tackle state.
Match state whose toString prints "CommonGame(players=..)", phase (TeamSelection..GameOver), surface, tier, winner, per-participant flags and queued moves.
MatchAgent whose toString prints "AgentTeamSelection" with ready flags and per-slot selection.
MatchAgent whose toString prints "AgentBall" with position, velocity, possessor, uncatchable and high-friction flags.
MatchAgent whose toString prints "AgentGoalState" with two team scores, goal count and goal scorer.
MatchAgent whose toString prints "AgentLineup" with per-participant lineup slots.
MatchAgent whose toString prints "AgentFormation" with per-team formation choices.

namingTool.adaptation: Resolve named member/local class binary prefixes from javac declaration simple names, preserving local ordinals and dollar characters. Compose containing-class renames recursively, including untouched top-level dollar names. Constructors, owner/type descriptors, literal loading, lexical labels and all bindings are recompiled and verified; output collisions fail before publication.
